title: Denovo
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
gap: Vibe-coding produced a wave of builders with zero business skills, and tooling for 'make my toy app make money' is thin — but this entry needs first-hand evidence (a paying user, an earnest complaint) before promotion.

zh.gap: vibe-coding 造出了一大批毫无商业技能的开发者，『让我的小 app 赚钱』的工具还很薄——但这条需要一手证据（一个付费用户、一句认真的抱怨）才能升档。
zh.pain: 能把 app 写出来、却不会把免费用户变成收入的独立开发者——285 个 PH 赞说明焦虑是真的；付费证据暂时无法核查。
zh.kill: 应用商店、Stripe、各分析平台都比它离钱更近；『洞察』类产品在建议无法直接抬收入的那一刻就死了。
zh.move: 若证据出现：中文独立开发者/小程序侧比英文侧更空。

pain: Indie vibe-coders who shipped an app but can't turn free users into revenue — 285 PH upvotes say the anxiety is real; paying evidence is not yet checkable.
kill: App stores, Stripe and analytics platforms all sit closer to the money; 'insights' products die the moment the advice doesn't visibly move revenue.
move: If evidence appears: the Chinese indie / 小程序 developer side is even more underserved than the English one.
